card.name: Linking words inside body-part and condition lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, or, the, of) or qualifiers like Chronic and Long right after a body region or condition term, in section headings and lists, where a second item or qualifier follows.

modes.description: And, or, and/or after a first anatomical term, before a second one.
